description: A scorecard table with inline sparklines for Power BI — multiple metrics per row, each with a value and a trend mini-chart, ideal for performance reviews where you want to see both the number and its trajectory in a compact grid. Codex Sparkline Table is the visual you reach for when a regular table doesn't say enough but a full chart per metric is too much. IDEAL FOR Multi-metric scorecards (per region, per product, per team) Executive performance reviews Service level dashboards across multiple SLAs KPI matrices where the trend is part of the story Replacing rows of separate KPI + chart pairs with a single table KEY FEATURES Multiple measures per row, each with optional sparkline Configurable sparkline colour, line width, and area fill Last-point dot on each sparkline Resizable column widths, with sortable columns and configurable sort direction Header font and styling controls Full font controls on every text element Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Hover tooltip showing row, measure, value, and trend details Click to cross-filter other visuals High contrast mode support PRO TIP Sort the rows by the leading metric so the table tells a story — top performers at the top. The sparkline column tells the secondary story: "this region is top now, but the trend is sliding." Built by Nexus Codex. Part of a growing collection of premium Power BI…
